title: Placement Evidence
description: Seller-attested evidence artifact proving a physical placement ran — a posting photograph for an OOH face, a tearsheet page for a print insertion. Channel-neutral: this record carries the artifact facts; what the artifact proves (posting, rotation, insertion) is declared by the containing record's event semantics. Third-party audit convention: the artifact should be geotagged and timestamped within the placement period, with the creative legible.

url.description: The evidence artifact — photograph, scanned tearsheet, or evidence package

notes.description: Context that doesn't fit the structured fields (e.g., 'shot from the eastbound approach at 40mph equivalent')
